post.description:
Check claims, or an AI answer, against the supplied documents.

Closed world and deterministic: relevant passages are selected from the documents,
a conservative stance detector labels them and the ADR-002 Judge decides. Each
piece of evidence carries exact character offsets; the response carries the SHA-256
of every document and the version of every component.

post.description:
Compare submitted field values (amount, date, CPF/CNPJ, names) with a document.

Deterministic: each field is located next to its labels and normalised by type;
the outcome is conforme, divergente (with the document's value and excerpt),
ausente (abstention) or invalido (malformed expected value).

status.title: Status
status.description: Judge verdict, or an abstention policy.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: Judge verdict; null when the system abstains.

text.title: Text
text.description: Full document text. Provide either text or content_base64.

content_base64.title: Content Base64
content_base64.description: Base64 file content (PDF with a text layer, or UTF-8 text).

source_sha256.title: Source Sha256
source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original uploaded bytes or text.

start.title: Start
start.description: Inclusive character offset in the document.

end.title: End
end.description: Exclusive character offset in the document.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Claims to check, verbatim. Provide either claims or answer.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: An AI answer to decompose into claims. Provide either claims or answer.

scope_note.title: Scope Note
scope_note.default: Closed-world check against the supplied documents only. Under the ADR-002 Judge, 'partially_supported' means support from a single independent source and 'verified' support from two or more independent documents. An abstention means the documents do not establish the claim; it is not a statement that the claim is false.

start_offset.title: Start Offset
start_offset.description: Inclusive start offset in the source text.

end_offset.title: End Offset
end_offset.description: Exclusive end offset; must be greater than start_offset.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels that introduce the field in the document (e.g. 'Vencimento').

scope_note.title: Scope Note
scope_note.default: Deterministic field comparison against the supplied document only. 'ausente' means the value was not located next to the field labels; it is an abstention, not a finding of error.

end_offset.title: End Offset
end_offset.description: Exclusive end offset in source text; must be within the RFC 8785 safe-integer range.

Judge2AtomRequest.title: Judge2AtomRequest
Judge2AtomRequest.description: Strict public schema for a Judge 2 atom and its source-text span.

end_offset.title: End Offset
end_offset.description: Must be greater than start_offset; the relational invariant is enforced by the API and Judge 2.

Judge2EvidenceRequest.title: Judge2EvidenceRequest
Judge2EvidenceRequest.description: Strict r2-a evidence shape; relational offsets are adjudicated by Judge 2.

Judge2StanceRequest.title: Judge2StanceRequest
Judge2StanceRequest.description: Strict public schema for an explicit atom/evidence stance edge.

Judge2VerificationRequest.title: Judge2VerificationRequest
Judge2VerificationRequest.description: Strict JSON contract for the r2-a Judge 2.0.0 API path.

Judge2VerificationResponse.title: Judge2VerificationResponse
Judge2VerificationResponse.description: Additive r2-a response with explanations derived from canonical output.

ResponsePolicy.title: ResponsePolicy
ResponsePolicy.description: Transport-level abstention policy; never a factual verdict.

max_agents.title: Max Agents
max_agents.description: Preferred form: JSON integer. Legacy coercion is preserved for compatibility: numeric strings (e.g. "5"), integral floats and booleans are still accepted for backward compatibility; removal is not scheduled before v0.6.0.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: No factual verdict was adjudicated. Submit structured claims and evidence to /v1/verify for formal verification.
